title: Insta360
desc: 360 cameras, action cameras, gimbals and webcams

pages.t: Insta360 was founded in 2015 and calls itself the world's leading 360 camera brand, citing a Frost and Sullivan report on 2023 market share. Its founder is JK Liu. Offices include Los Angeles, Tokyo, Berlin, Shenzhen and Hong Kong.
g: 360 camera
A camera that records the whole sphere around it, not just one direction.

pages.t: Today the range covers 360 cameras, action cameras, tiny hands-free cameras, gimbal cameras, phone gimbals, webcams, microphones and accessories. The brand is built around people who want to capture and share moments, from riders to creators.
g: Gimbal
A motorised holder that keeps a camera or phone steady while you move.

pages.t: Insta360 also sells through its own online store, and through resellers. Allnet Nordic is a distributor: we supply resellers, and they sell to the end customer. So you need to know the lines and which customer buys each one.
g: Distributor
Buys from the vendor and sells to resellers, not to end users.

quiz.q: Which description fits Insta360 best?
o: A security camera maker for offices
A brand best known for 360 cameras, now with a wider range of cameras and gear
A phone maker that also sells cameras
quiz.w: Insta360 started with 360 cameras in 2015 and now also makes action cameras, gimbals and webcams.

quiz.q: Who is Allnet's direct customer for Insta360?
o: The person who films their ride
The reseller who sells to end customers
quiz.w: A distributor sells to resellers. Resellers sell on to the end customer.

quiz.q: What does Insta360 itself say about its position?
o: It is the world's leading 360 camera brand, based on a market share report
It is the biggest action camera brand overall
It only makes cameras for professionals
quiz.w: The about page cites a Frost and Sullivan report on panoramic (360) cameras. It makes no claim about all action cameras.

pages.t: A 360 camera has lenses facing opposite ways and joins the pictures into one sphere. You press record and capture everything around you at once. The camera does the joining for you.
g: Stitching
Joining the pictures from several lenses into one seamless image.

pages.t: The big idea is shoot first, frame later. Record without aiming, then pick the best angles in the Insta360 app. This is called reframing. Nobody misses the moment because the camera was pointing the wrong way.
g: Reframing
Choosing the viewing angle and crop after the footage has been recorded.

pages.t: The camera sees in every direction, so a selfie stick held below it can be hidden in the result. The footage looks like a drone or a second cameraman filmed it. Insta360 shows this trick prominently on its product pages.

quiz.q: What does 'shoot first, frame later' mean?
o: You record everything around you and choose the angle afterwards
You take photos first and video later
You edit on the camera before recording
quiz.w: A 360 camera captures every direction, so the framing happens in the app after recording.

quiz.q: Why does the selfie stick seem to disappear?
o: It is made of clear plastic
The camera sees all around and the stick is hidden in the result
The camera blurs anything near it
quiz.w: Insta360 says the stick is not in sight in the final footage, which gives third-person, drone-like angles.

quiz.q: A customer keeps missing shots because they point the camera the wrong way. Which idea helps?
quiz.w: Because a 360 camera records every direction, nothing is missed and the angle is chosen later.

pages.t: The X series is the core 360 camera line. On the homepage (checked 21 Oct 2026) X6 is called the flagship 8K 360 camera and X5 the best value 8K 360 camera.
g: 8K
Very high video resolution: 8K has about 16 times the pixels of Full HD, and four times 4K.

pages.t: X5 and X6 both have replaceable lenses, so a scratched lens can be swapped instead of replacing the camera. They also offer the invisible selfie stick effect, FlowState stabilisation and a horizon lock that keeps videos level.
g: FlowState
Insta360's software stabilisation that smooths out shake without a gimbal.

pages.t: The X series can also record normal flat video, so it can act like an action camera. X5 is waterproof to 15 m, and the Invisible Dive Case is made for deeper underwater 360 shots. Best fit: riders, travellers and creators who want every angle.

quiz.q: Which X model does Insta360 call its flagship?
quiz.w: On the homepage checked 21 Oct 2026, X6 is the flagship 8K 360 camera.

quiz.q: A customer is worried about scratching the lens. What is a good point about X5 and X6?
o: They can only be used indoors
quiz.w: Replaceable lenses mean a damaged lens can be swapped without replacing the whole camera.

quiz.q: What does the horizon lock do?
o: Keeps the video level even when the camera tilts
Locks the camera to one phone
quiz.w: The horizon lock keeps footage anchored to the skyline, useful for bikes and tight turns.

pages.t: Ace Pro 2 is the traditional action camera: one lens facing forward, small, rugged and waterproof. An action camera is usually mounted on a helmet, chest or handlebar and left to record.
g: Action camera
A small rugged camera for filming sport and adventure, mounted on a helmet, bike or body.

pages.t: The lens is co-engineered with Leica and the sensor is a 1/1.3 inch 8K one. Other points: a flip screen, a built-in wind guard for clearer sound, and a wide-angle lens made for POV shots, for example on two wheels.
g: POV
Point of view: footage that shows what you see.

pages.t: It is waterproof to 12 m out of the box, and to 60 m with the Dive Case. A removable lens guard protects the lens. Best fit: riders, divers and sports customers who want one robust camera, not a 360 one.

quiz.q: Which company co-engineered the Ace Pro 2 lens?
quiz.w: The Ace Pro 2 page names a Leica Summarit lens co-engineered with Leica.

quiz.q: A customer wants a small rugged camera that points forward and is simple to use. Which line fits?
quiz.w: Ace Pro 2 is the single-lens action camera. Link is a webcam and Flow is a phone gimbal.

quiz.q: How does the Ace Pro 2 handle water out of the box?
o: Only a screen cover makes it waterproof
quiz.w: The product page states waterproof to 39 ft (12 m), deeper with the Dive Case.

lessons.title: GO Ultra and GO 3S: tiny cameras

pages.t: The GO line is Insta360's ultra-small camera family. GO Ultra weighs just 53 g and shoots 4K. It attaches with magnets, a pendant, a clip or sticky tabs, so it films from your point of view without holding it.
g: Magnetic mount
A mount that holds the camera with magnets, so it clicks on and off in seconds.

pages.t: The small camera of the GO Ultra can sit in the Action Pod. The pod adds a flip touchscreen and a much longer battery life. The camera also works alone, for example stuck to a helmet or a stroller.
g: Action Pod
The pocket-sized holder that adds a screen and battery to the small GO camera.

pages.t: On the homepage (21 Oct 2026) GO Ultra is the tiny hands-free 4K camera, and GO 3S is a tiny 4K camera that is still listed beside it. GO suits vlogs, cycling, running and travel, when a bigger camera feels like too much.

quiz.q: What is the main idea of the GO line?
o: The smallest cameras for hands-free POV shooting
quiz.w: GO cameras are tiny and mount anywhere, for hands-free POV video.

quiz.q: What does the Action Pod add?
o: A flip screen and extra battery for the small camera
quiz.w: The pod gives the small GO camera a touchscreen and longer battery life.

quiz.q: A customer wants a camera to stick on a bike helmet and forget. Which fits best?
quiz.w: GO is built for hands-free mounting, including on helmets and handlebars.

pages.t: The Flow 2 series (Flow 2, Flow 2 Plus, Flow 2 Pro) holds a smartphone and keeps it steady and pointed at you. Flow 2 Pro uses Apple's tracking, so it can follow a person in the iPhone camera app and many other iOS apps.
g: 3-axis stabilisation
The gimbal steadies the phone on three directions of movement.
Tracking
The gimbal turns on its own to keep a person in the frame.

pages.t: Flow 2 has a built-in tripod and selfie stick, works as a power bank and has a teleprompter function. The separate AI Tracker that tracks in any app, iOS or Android, is included in Flow 2 Plus, not in Flow 2 or Flow 2 Pro.
g: Teleprompter
A scrolling script on screen so you can read while looking at the camera.

pages.t: Luna Ultra is a different thing: a camera with the gimbal built in, no phone needed. It has a Leica Summicron lens with a 1 inch 8K sensor, a telephoto lens and a detachable 2 inch touchscreen. The Luna series is listed as new.

quiz.q: What is the key difference between Flow 2 and Luna Ultra?
o: Flow 2 holds your phone, Luna Ultra is a camera with a built-in gimbal
Flow 2 is a webcam, Luna Ultra a drone
They are the same product in two colours
quiz.w: Flow 2 is a phone gimbal. Luna Ultra is a standalone gimbal camera.

quiz.q: A customer wants a gimbal that follows them in any iOS or Android app. Which Flow 2 model includes the AI Tracker?
quiz.w: The page says the AI Tracker is part of Flow 2 Plus and not included with Flow 2 or Flow 2 Pro.

quiz.q: Which customer fits Flow 2 Pro best?
o: A diver who needs a waterproof camera
A rider who wants a helmet camera
An iPhone user who vlogs and wants steady, tracked footage
quiz.w: Flow 2 Pro tracks in the iPhone camera and iOS apps, which suits phone vloggers.

pages.t: For a motorcyclist or cyclist who wants every angle and a level horizon, an X series 360 camera fits. If they only want a forward view, Ace Pro 2 is the action camera. For a light helmet camera, GO Ultra is the tiny option.
g: Horizon lock
Keeps the video level even if the camera tilts.

pages.t: A travel creator who wants drone-like shots and does not want to aim should get a 360 camera. A phone vlogger who films mostly with an iPhone suits Flow 2 Pro. A diver needs Ace Pro 2 or an X camera, each with its Dive Case.

Good first question: what do you film and where is the camera? Always forward, mounted and rugged leads to Ace Pro 2. Tiny and hands-free leads to GO. Every angle, chosen later, leads to X. Phone-based leads to Flow.

quiz.q: A cyclist wants to film every angle around the bike and choose later. Which line?
quiz.w: A 360 camera records all directions and lets you reframe afterwards.

quiz.q: A runner wants the smallest possible hands-free camera. Which line?
quiz.w: GO Ultra is the tiny hands-free camera.

quiz.q: An iPhone vlogger wants tracked, steady shots using the phone's own camera. Which line?
quiz.w: Flow 2 Pro is the phone gimbal with Apple tracking.

quiz.q: Which customer is best matched with Ace Pro 2?
o: Someone who wants a webcam for calls
Someone who wants to film all directions
Someone who wants a single forward-facing rugged camera
quiz.w: Ace Pro 2 is a classic single-lens rugged action camera.

pages.t: Insta360 sells a lot beyond the camera. For the X series the pages list selfie sticks (including an extended one up to 3 m), a Mic Air wireless microphone, a quick release mount, a fast-charge case and the Invisible Dive Case.
g: Attach sale
An extra product sold together with the main product.

pages.t: GO accessories include a Flexi Strap mount for helmets and handlebars, an Easy Clip headband for running, a Ring Remote and sticky tabs. These can be bought on their own, so each camera sale can carry an accessory sale.

The invisible selfie stick effect only works with a stick, so the stick is close to a must-have for 360 customers. A mount for the activity and a spare battery are other natural add-ons. Ask: how will the camera be carried or held?

quiz.q: Which accessory does the invisible selfie stick effect depend on?
quiz.w: The effect hides the stick, so customers need a stick to use it.

quiz.q: A reseller sells a GO Ultra to a cyclist. Which accessory is a natural add-on?
quiz.w: The Flexi Strap mounts the camera to helmet or handlebars.

quiz.q: Why are accessories useful to a reseller?
o: Insta360 only sells them in stores
They can be sold together with each camera
quiz.w: Accessories can be bought separately, so each camera sale can carry an extra sale.

pages.t: Footage is edited in the Insta360 app on the phone, with AI tools such as AI Director, which picks the best moments and builds a clip, and AI Frame, which suggests angles. Insta360 Studio is the editor for Mac and Windows computers.
g: AI Director
A feature that picks the best moments from footage and makes a finished clip.

pages.t: Insta360+ is a paid subscription. It offers cloud auto-backup (it can free space on the SD card), cloud editing, easy 360 sharing and online playback. It supports files from the 360 cameras, Ace Pro 2 and GO Ultra. Plans differ by storage.
g: Subscription
A service you pay for monthly or yearly.

pages.t: FlexiCare is bought separately for supported models and covers accidental damage such as cracked screens, lens damage and water damage, with low-cost replacements. The standard warranty only covers product defects. This matters for riders and divers, who are hard on cameras.

quiz.q: What does the standard warranty cover?
quiz.w: The coverage page says the standard warranty only covers product defects.

quiz.q: A customer shoots a lot and is worried the SD card fills up. Which service helps?
quiz.w: Cloud auto-backup can also delete files from the SD card to free space.

quiz.q: A diver worries about water damage by accident. What do you mention?
quiz.w: FlexiCare covers accidental damage including water damage, which the standard warranty does not.

src.l: Insta360 Link 2 Pro and Link 2C Pro

pages.t: Insta360 has an Enterprise side for businesses. For real estate, it promotes virtual tours: shoot 360 photos room by room, upload to a tour platform and share a link. The page lists X4 and X3 as tour cameras, plus a Virtual Tour Kit.
g: Virtual tour
An online walk-through of a place made from 360 photos.

pages.t: The page names tour partners such as Floorfy, Realsee and Avatour, and a free SDK so companies can control the cameras from their own app. Other industries listed are construction, live streaming, Google Street View, media and education.
g: SDK
A toolkit that lets other companies build software that works with a product.

pages.t: Link 2 Pro and Link 2C Pro are AI 4K webcams for meetings and streams. Link 2 Pro physically pans and tilts to follow you, while Link 2C Pro keeps people in frame by zooming. They are a different buyer from a camera shopper.

quiz.q: A real estate agent wants virtual tours. Which approach fits?
o: 360 photos of each room shared as a tour
quiz.w: The Enterprise real estate page describes 360 photos turned into virtual tours.

quiz.q: What is the difference between Link 2 Pro and Link 2C Pro?
o: Link 2 Pro pans and tilts, Link 2C Pro keeps people in frame by zooming
Link 2 Pro is underwater, 2C is not
quiz.w: The page says Link 2 Pro moves physically, while Link 2C Pro adjusts the frame itself.

quiz.q: Who buys a Link webcam?
o: Someone doing meetings or streams who wants better video
quiz.w: Link is for conferencing and streaming, not for sport.

pages.t: Action cameras are small, rugged, often waterproof cameras for mounting on helmets, bikes and bodies. GoPro is a well known name in the category, and DJI, with its Osmo Action line, is another well known name. Expect customers to compare.
g: Category
The group of similar products that customers compare.

pages.t: With a single-lens action camera, customers compare image quality, stabilisation and size. Insta360's own difference is 360 capture: reframing later, the invisible selfie stick and one camera for many angles. X5 and X6 add replaceable lenses.

Do not claim who is better on specs: you cannot check them here. Ask what the customer films. If they want every angle and no aiming, lead with 360. If they want one forward view, show Ace Pro 2 and let them compare it.

quiz.q: What is Insta360's clearest difference from a classic action camera?
o: It is the only waterproof camera
quiz.w: Insta360's own point of difference is shooting in every direction and framing later.

quiz.q: A customer says they only want a forward-facing camera. What do you do?
o: Show Ace Pro 2 and let them compare
quiz.w: For a single forward view, Ace Pro 2 is the right line.

quiz.q: Which statement is safest to say in a sales talk?
o: We beat every competitor on specs
Insta360's 360 capture lets you choose the angle after filming
quiz.w: This is a verified feature. Claims about winning on specs cannot be backed up here.

pages.t: Editing is hard: AI Director and AI Frame in the app build clips for you. Lens will scratch: X5 and X6 have replaceable lenses, and X5 advises lens protection outdoors. Wind noise: X5 and Ace Pro 2 have a wind guard.

My phone is enough: a phone is awkward to mount on a helmet, handlebar or stick, and risky to take into water or rough use. What about battery? Insta360 quotes lab tests, so ask how long the customer films.

Ask the reseller's customer: What do you film? Where is the camera mounted? Phone or computer for editing? Underwater? Do you want cloud backup? The answers point to the line, the accessories and whether FlexiCare is worth mentioning.

quiz.q: A customer says editing 360 video sounds hard. What is a good reply?
o: The app has AI tools such as AI Director that build a clip for you
quiz.w: The X pages list AI Director and AI Frame to simplify editing.

quiz.q: A customer worries the lens will scratch on a bike. What do you mention for X5 or X6?
quiz.w: Replaceable lenses let you swap a damaged lens, and lens protection is advised outdoors.

quiz.q: Which is the best first question for a new customer?
o: What do you film and where is the camera?
quiz.w: What and where leads to the right line and the right accessories.

about: Camera maker founded in 2015, best known for 360 cameras. Also makes action cameras, tiny cameras, gimbals and webcams, and says it is the world's leading 360 camera brand.
Sells to riders, travel creators and phone vloggers, and to businesses that need virtual tours or webcams, through its own store and resellers.
Different because a 360 camera captures everything at once and you choose the framing afterwards, including the invisible selfie stick trick.
